concerns.text: Spec US1 requires collecting demographic data (Age, Education) and exporting to CSV. Tasks T022e (Capture Data) and T022g_impl (Export Logic) are marked incomplete [ ]. Without these, the core data collection requirement for US1 is unimplementable.

Spec US2 requires a Statistical Analysis Pipeline. Task T024a (Preprocess script) is marked incomplete [ ]. This task is a prerequisite for T025a_b (ANOVA) and T026_integrated (Pairwise tests). Missing T024a blocks the entire US2 implementation.

Spec US0 requires redirecting to a withdrawal page on 'I Do Not Agree'. Task T062_new (Implement Withdrawal Logging) is marked incomplete [ ]. While T015 handles the redirect, the Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) and audit requirements imply a need for logging withdrawals. The missing task leaves a gap in the audit trail.

Task T063 references `torch.manual_seed` for reproducibility. The Spec and Plan Technical Context list only CPU-based libraries (numpy, scipy, statsmodels) with no PyTorch dependency. This tag references a non-existent requirement/dependency in the current spec/plan, creating a stale tag.
